scope: V13 development diagnostics at the three already observed waiting states. No independent dates.
objective: Remaining seconds up to the original journey deadline, from immediate alight after the publicly recorded prefix. Original station-transfer declarations and pickup restrictions, same integer clock and no implicit remote messages.

policy_panel.random_stream: Original V13 independent 64 draws per root, SeedSequence([20261113,int(date),query,decision]); actual waiting replays preserve unresolved source intervals.
policy_panel.control: Unmodified V13 first_visible, original incumbent during compilation and publication with measured latency.
policy_panel.menu: A/B are the original two first connection IDs. Add every legal scheduled connection at the waiting stop within 720 seconds after transfer readiness with a valid deterministic timetable itinerary to the destination. Freeze paths, IDs and scores before generating worlds.
policy_panel.public_policies: Retain first_visible if no extra candidate wins. The guarded policy requires a strictly earlier shifted timetable arrival than the viable A/B comparison. The other takes the first visible extra vehicle unless first_visible would board then and its choice has an equal or better score. After the additional first connection use its frozen timetable suffix, subject to the same physical execution.
policy_panel.hindsight: Take the best legally catchable first connection from the given menu and then the same full-graph clairvoyant suffix. Also log full-menu hindsight. In the follow-up, replay the same tapes and replace only the suffix following each policy's selected first connection by that oracle. This separates two point differences under hindsight. These restricted diagnostics do not certify causal optima.
policy_panel.inference: Report paired loss, arrival, cost and signed gain lower bounds over IID posterior worlds separately per root. Bonferroni .05 over both extensions and all three roots. Cap is the original deadline minus the root clock.

bank_trace_panel: Rebuild all 24 V13 product banks on the exact archived random streams. Preserve the V13 action and stop contract and reproduce the bank values.

city_ablation_panel.baseline: Original A/B atoms and common rest seeds. Full platform actions and the V13 transfer clock.
city_ablation_panel.candidate_r: Public timetable rule at the root, independent of realized sampled or actual event times.
city_ablation_panel.budget: 50,000 information nodes per attempted solve. For the conditional suffix and R experiments expand only prespecified finite factor supports. For the delayed-tail experiment compare original and delayed public boundaries on the same rows. Budget failures have no value.
city_ablation_panel.statistical_unit: Independent outer banks. Product rows within one bank share draws and are not independent.

cost: Time public context, candidate paths, binding, applicability, rule calls, posterior sampling, packing, model construction and solve as applicable. Report shared fit/compile and offline evaluation separately.
